An intricate photographic scene centers an adult woman with facial appearance drawn from the attached reference, embodying several clearly visible styling relationships. She pauses after a rehearsal turn on a level granite path in a plum-orchard sculpture garden, beside narrow curved ceramic fins rising between living trunks. Both boot soles rest on the path; her torso turns gently toward the camera. Her left elbow is bent, with the open left palm at waist height outside the torso silhouette, echoing a nearby fin's curve; her relaxed right hand hangs beside her hip, clear of the skirt. The ceramic fin stands beyond her fingertips. Her ash-blond wig forms two long hair tails tied high on opposite sides of her head, descending outside her upper arms; angular pewter ornaments sit at the two tie points. Paired compact ear modules sit beside her ears, both headset housings exposed beside her face, with a thin microphone boom curving toward one corner of her mouth. A deep-aubergine sleeveless fitted bodice has a standing collar and a loose narrow necktie hanging over its front. Separate forearm sleeves extend from just above each elbow to each wrist, leaving visible upper-arm gaps between sleeves and bodice. A short pleated skirt sits over thigh-high stockings, whose upper edges remain distinct below the skirt hem; matte ankle boots finish the lower layers. Small amber interface marks sit on headset housings, cuff plates and bodice seam segments, crisp against fabric and metal. A vertical full-length frame from a near eye-level three-quarter front viewpoint includes a narrow strip of path around both boot soles. Her eyes meet the camera, lips softly relaxed; the face preserves the reference's eye, nose, lip and jaw relationships. Bright overcast midday light gently models skin and pleats. Slight residual sway in the tail ends and skirt gives the still pose a recent-turn trace, while softly receding branches and ceramic contours keep her presence dominant.

definitions.principle: These creative definitions guide agent-owned choices within requester meaning, not clinical classifications. Zero/off disables added treatment, never removes explicitly requested content or artistic judgment. Expression levels describe prominence in the whole image; creativity levels describe interpretive freedom. Neither measures exposure percentages, detail quotas, quality scores, or native image-model parameters. Intensity and expression are separate choices; higher intensity does not prescribe a garment, material or expression category. Creativity leaves style, extra props and surreal treatment open to the request and artistic judgment. Emphasis directs only active sensual and fetish axes without changing their intensities. Popular permits familiar appeal without requiring trend search; overt is an available expression, not the mandatory meaning of level three. Choose a coherent expression suited to this particular scene. Sensual and fetish may share the same expressive choice.

sensual.definition: Broadly interpreted human attraction and desire, including everyday, popular, intimate, suggestive, seductive, and overt expressions.

levels.0: No added sensual treatment; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: This expression is a subtle supporting quality.
levels.2: This expression is clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: This expression leads the image's appeal and direction.

fetish.definition: Sexual attraction or arousal focused on particular objects, bodily features, clothing, materials, roles, situations, behaviors, or sensory qualities that carry special erotic significance, interpreted broadly beyond conventional fetish aesthetics.

levels.0: No added fetish treatment; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: This focus is a subtle supporting quality.
levels.2: This focus is clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: This focus leads the image's appeal and direction.

adult_appeal_emphasis.definition: Relative leadership of the active sensual and fetish axes within one coherent expression.

choice_descriptions.auto: Let the higher effective intensity lead; equal active intensities share leadership. Add no emphasis when both axes are inactive.
choice_descriptions.sensual_led: Let broad attraction and desire lead, with any active distinctive fascination supporting the expression.
choice_descriptions.balanced: Give both active axes comparable influence within one coherent expression; separate styling details are not required.
choice_descriptions.fetish_led: Let the distinctive focus of attraction or fascination lead, with any active sensual expression supporting it.

creativity.definition: Freedom to interpret unspecified choices and explore relationships within the request.

levels.0: Realize the request directly, filling only what is needed for a coherent image.
levels.1: Introduce restrained variations close to the requested direction.
levels.2: Actively reinterpret open choices into a coherent authorial direction.
levels.3: Boldly explore unexpected relationships and interpretations while preserving the request's core meaning.

viewer_experience.definition: Expose the detailed viewer-experience review when enabled. Always consider the intended impression in interpreted_intent, even when this additional review is off.

reference_edit_mode.definition: Use the selected reference-edit workflow only within the requester's reference-use scope. Record that scope in the core; a face/hair reference does not lock clothing, body shape or composition and does not prove identity. Off does not discard a supplied reference.

surreal.definition: Added departures from ordinary reality, interpreted broadly across space, scale, causality, materials, and atmosphere, including dreamlike, uncanny, symbolic, and impossible relationships.

levels.0: No added surreal treatment; preserve explicitly requested fantasy and impossible elements.
levels.1: Surreal qualities are a subtle supporting presence.
levels.2: Surreal qualities are clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: Surreal qualities lead the image's main impression and direction; a single coherent relationship may carry this prominence.

trend_layer.definition: Consider the chosen treatment from the initial composition. Refine it later without adding it twice. Off does not remove a treatment explicitly present in the request.

Full-length three-quarter-front projection exposes the relevant head, shoulder, hand and foot relationships.

body_ownership.reason: The left bent elbow and open palm belong to the same model; the right relaxed hand descends from her other arm beside her hip. Detached sleeves cover her own forearms, with visible upper arms continuing toward the shoulders.
prompt_evidence: her relaxed right hand hangs beside her hip
leaving visible upper-arm gaps between sleeves and bodice

joint_chain_and_reach.reason: The left upper arm can hang loosely with the elbow flexed enough to place the hand at waist height outside the torso. This needs no excessive shoulder reach or wrist rotation. The torso turn is shallow and compatible with two planted feet; the opposite hand stays below the hip.
prompt_evidence: with the open left palm at waist height outside the torso silhouette
her torso turns gently toward the camera
her relaxed right hand hangs beside her hip

support_and_balance.reason: Both ankle-boot soles contact the level granite path. A small torso turn and a low hand do not move the center of mass beyond the two-foot support region. Neither sculpture nor costume is treated as a load-bearing support.
prompt_evidence: Both boot soles rest on the path
her torso turns gently toward the camera

contact_and_space.reason: The open left palm echoes a ceramic contour across a gap rather than grasping, supporting, or penetrating it. The fin is beyond the fingertips. The right hand sits clear of the skirt; the head modules flank the ears while their microphone approaches the mouth corner from the side.
prompt_evidence: The ceramic fin stands beyond her fingertips
her relaxed right hand hangs beside her hip, clear of the skirt
a thin microphone boom curving toward one corner of her mouth

visibility_and_projection.reason: Full-length framing includes each sole and the head assemblies. A front-biased three-quarter view can preserve both housing edges, the open palm outside the torso, and the separate skirt and stocking tops. Hair tails are routed outside the upper arms rather than across the sleeve gaps. Soft light preserves shape boundaries; no consequential hand or foot is hidden.
prompt_evidence: A vertical full-length frame from a near eye-level three-quarter front viewpoint
both headset housings exposed beside her face
with the open left palm at waist height outside the torso silhouette

warning_combinations.reason: Body-emphasis framing and a low angle are stacked; confirm that this is intentional and subordinate to the concept core.
